mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a sustained increase in FEDFUNDS rates signals higher discount rates applied to equity cash flows, leading to negative 20-day forward S&P 500 returns as investors anticipate reduced profit margins.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not negative in >60% of instances during tightening cycles, or FEDFUNDS shows no correlation with returns when IC <0.05 over 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When GDPC1 exceeds 15,000, it indicates strong demand growth, which compresses discount rates and enhances equity valuations, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive when GDPC1 >15000 (p>0.05), or IC <0.1 over 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A convergence between rising GDPC1 (GDP growth) and RSAFS (industrial production) signals robust demand and supply expansion, amplifying corporate profits and driving positive 20-day S&P returns.
failure_condition: 20d returns not positive when both GDPC1 and RSAFS are rising (p>0.05), or IC >0.2 over 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in UNRATE below 3.5% indicates strengthening labor market conditions, boosting consumer confidence and corporate profits, which drive positive 60-day S&P forward returns.
failure_condition: 60d returns not positive when UNRATE <3.5 (p>0.05), or IC <0.15 over 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, near-zero FEDFUNDS rates signal accommodative policy, sustaining equity valuations and generating positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20d returns not positive in >50% of late-cycle instances, or FEDFUNDS >0.01 with IC >0.1 over 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in INDPRO above its 12-month average indicates robust supply growth, reducing inflationary pressures and fostering equity market optimism, driving positive 20-day S&P returns.
failure_condition: 20d returns not positive when INDPRO is above trend (p>0.05), or IC <0.1 over 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in UNRATE coupled with rising PAYEMS signals a strengthening labor market, enhancing consumer spending and corporate profits, which amplifies S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: 60d returns not positive when UNRATE falls and PAYEMS rises (p>0.05), or IC >0.2 over 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: When INDPRO exceeds 107.3, it signals robust industrial production, reducing supply chain bottlenecks and boosting corporate earnings, which drive positive 20-day S&P returns.
failure_condition: 20d returns not positive when INDPRO >107.3 (p>0.05), or IC <0.15 over 2-month window.
